Description:
Enhance your collection with this varied assortment of loose crystal and mineral specimens in tumbled, rough, pointed, and clustered forms. Each piece presents unique natural colors and textures, ranging from delicate purple clusters and mint green chunks to polished gray and pink stones, as well as translucent pale-yellow points and geode slices with sparkling interiors. The selection is ideal for display, hands-on study, or decorative use. These crystals are individually distinct, giving visual appeal and tactile interest for collectors, students, or hobbyists interested in geology and natural minerals. All pieces are stand-alone specimens, not designed for jewelry, electronics, or glassware use. Surfaces vary from glossy and smooth to rough and jagged, allowing for versatile arrangement. Condition is pre-owned with typical signs of handling, but no major flaws are apparent from available images. This is a versatile assortment that offers both educational and aesthetic benefits to any geological collection

284745083.description:
Mixed lot of crystal and mineral pieces including three polished tower points in golden brown, smoky brown and green and white, a split geode with druse crystals, and a carved stone skull. Also included are a carved green figure, a small carved animal, a bag holding one small specimen, and roughly twenty raw stones in yellow, black, clear, green and red tones. A pendulum with an orange stone drop on a gold tone chain with a toggle bar is part of the lot.

Condition: Pre-owned. Raw pieces have rough edges and natural chips, loose grit and small fragments are present, and the chain shows light wear.

284465315.description:
This natural agate geode bookend is made in Brazil, as indicated by the label on the base. It features a polished front and one side, revealing a crystalline quartz interior with banded agate edges in white, grey, brown, and green shades. The back and one side retain the rough natural stone exterior for contrast. Clear rubber feet are attached to the bottom for surface protection and stability. The bookend is in good used condition with no visible cracks or significant wear. It measures approximately 7 inches tall.

Item is used and subject to small imperfections not visible in pictures. Has Wearing-Scuffs-Smudges-Dust-Needs cleaning. Sold as is.
